lines.zh: 骨头在皮里响，走一步响一下。
lines.en: The bones rattle under my skin with every step.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的地面，踩上去发软。
lines.en: The Creeponia ground gives way under my feet.

lines.zh: 我没有脚掌，只有两根胫骨。
lines.en: I have no soles, only two shin bones.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为每步都在算距离。
lines.en: I walk slowly, measuring distance with each step.

lines.zh: 骨节摩擦，冒出一股焦味。
lines.en: My joints grind and give off a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 别跑远，我这条腿追得上。
lines.en: Do not run far; this leg can keep up.

lines.zh: 我的脊椎露在外面，一节一节。
lines.en: My spine shows through, vertebra by vertebra.

lines.zh: 走近点，再走近点就够了。
lines.en: Closer, just a little closer is enough.

lines.zh: 地上的裂纹，跟着我一起走。
lines.en: The cracks in the ground travel along with me.

lines.zh: 我拖着半具身体，速度不慢。
lines.en: I drag half a body and still move quickly.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里塞着旧火药。
lines.en: Old gunpowder is packed between my bones.

lines.zh: 我每一步都在往你那边偏。
lines.en: Every step of mine leans toward you.

lines.zh: 我站着，骨头自己在响。
lines.en: I stand still and my bones rattle on their own.

lines.zh: 火药在我胸腔里结块了。
lines.en: The gunpowder has clumped inside my chest.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度没有风，只有灰。
lines.en: Creeponia has no wind, only ash.

lines.zh: 我在等一根火柴，或一次碰撞。
lines.en: I am waiting for a match, or a collision.

lines.zh: 四十五点生命，烧起来只够一次。
lines.en: Forty-five points of life burns only once.

lines.zh: 我数自己的肋骨，少了三根。
lines.en: I count my ribs; three are missing.

lines.zh: 骨头白得发亮，灰却盖不住。
lines.en: My bones shine white, and the ash will not cover them.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是苦力怕，也记得不是。
lines.en: I remember being a creeper, and remember not being one.

lines.zh: 杀了我，能捡走火药和骨头。
lines.en: Kill me and you may take powder and bones.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见引信。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear a fuse.

lines.zh: 你的骨头，比我整齐。
lines.en: Your skeleton is neater than mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在量还剩几步。
lines.en: I stare at you to measure the remaining steps.

lines.zh: 你别眨眼，我怕跟丢。
lines.en: Do not blink; I might lose track of you.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，很新。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and it is fresh.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝空着，可我看得清。
lines.en: My sockets are empty, yet I see clearly.

lines.zh: 你在后退，我看得出来。
lines.en: You are backing away; I can tell.

lines.zh: 这张脸只剩骨头，别嫌丑。
lines.en: This face is only bone; do not call it ugly.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我很想靠近。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes me want to come closer.

lines.zh: 我把你的位置记在骨头上。
lines.en: I am carving your position into my bones.

lines.zh: 看什么？没见过会走的火药桶？
lines.en: What? Never seen a walking powder keg?

lines.zh: 断了，不过本来也不全。
lines.en: It broke, though it was not whole before.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我半张脸，我照走。
lines.en: You took half my face; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 骨头裂开的声音，我熟。
lines.en: The sound of bone splitting is familiar.

lines.zh: 别打关节，那里最容易散。
lines.en: Not the joints; that is where I come apart.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，很短。
lines.en: There is pain, but it is brief.

lines.zh: 我少了一只手，还有牙。
lines.en: I lost a hand and still have teeth.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让火药漏了。
lines.en: That hit made the powder leak.

lines.zh: 我跪下去，又撑起来。
lines.en: I dropped to a knee and pushed back up.

lines.zh: 骨头会碎，火不会。
lines.en: Bones break; fire does not.

lines.zh: 再砍，我就提前点了。
lines.en: Keep cutting and I light up early.

lines.zh: 骨头不吃东西，骨头只烧。
lines.en: Bones do not eat; bones only burn.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我闻不到。
lines.en: You raise meat high, and I smell nothing.

lines.zh: 火药比面包合我胃口。
lines.en: Gunpowder suits my appetite better than bread.

lines.zh: 拿开，我只对引火的东西有兴趣。
lines.en: Take it away; only things that catch fire interest me.

lines.zh: 我嘴里没有舌头，尝不出味。
lines.en: I have no tongue, so I taste nothing.

lines.zh: 那根木棍不错，能当引信。
lines.en: That stick is good; it could serve as a fuse.

lines.zh: 你喂我，是想让我慢下来？
lines.en: Feeding me is your way to slow me down?

lines.zh: 我饿，但饿的是火药。
lines.en: I am hungry, but it is gunpowder I hunger for.

lines.zh: 食物会烂，骨头不会。
lines.en: Food rots; bone does not.

lines.zh: 收好，别扔在灰里糟蹋。
lines.en: Keep it; do not let it rot in the ash.

lines.zh: 撞上了，正好，省得我点。
lines.en: We collided; perfect, no need to light up.

lines.zh: 你推我，我的骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: You shoved me and my bones clicked.

lines.zh: 再挤一下，我就要亮了。
lines.en: Squeeze once more and I will start glowing.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，火药在发热。
lines.en: We are pressed together and the powder is warming.

lines.zh: 别抱我，我身上有引信。
lines.en: Do not hug me; I have a fuse on me.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的下巴掉了。
lines.en: That impact knocked my jaw off.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的肋骨了，捡起来。
lines.en: You stepped on my rib; pick it up.

lines.zh: 我不怕撞，我怕撞得不够近。
lines.en: Impact does not scare me; being too far does.

lines.zh: 骨头磕骨头，声音又干又脆。
lines.en: Knocking bone on bone gives a clean, dry click.

lines.zh: 你退开了，可惜。
lines.en: You pulled away. What a pity.

lines.zh: 我只剩骨头，谈不上配对。
lines.en: I am only bone; pairing is out of the question.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度里，没有谁愿意靠近我。
lines.en: In Creeponia, nobody wants to come near me.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是那根引信。
lines.en: My partner is that fuse.

lines.zh: 我们若成一对，只会炸成一片。
lines.en: If we became a pair, we would only blow apart.

lines.zh: 骨头不会生骨头，只会散。
lines.en: Bone does not birth bone; it scatters.

lines.zh: 别找我同类，它们都烧完了。
lines.en: Do not look for my kind; they all burned out.

lines.zh: 我只和火药成对出现。
lines.en: I only ever appear paired with gunpowder.

lines.zh: 你问得像个牧师，可惜没有婚礼。
lines.en: You ask like a priest, but there is no wedding.

lines.zh: 我一个人就够吵了。
lines.en: I am noisy enough on my own.

lines.zh: 这事先放放，我快点了。
lines.en: Put that aside; I am nearly lit.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的指骨，装回去。
lines.en: I pick up my own finger bone and put it back.

lines.zh: 这块石头，能压住我的胸腔。
lines.en: This stone could weigh down my chest.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的骨头，都是我的。
lines.en: Any bone on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡火药，不捡别的。
lines.en: I pick up gunpowder and nothing else.

lines.zh: 捡起来的时候，我的手指断了。
lines.en: While picking it up, my finger snapped off.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进肋骨之间。
lines.en: I tuck things between my ribs.

lines.zh: 这个能当引信吗？试试。
lines.en: Could this serve as a fuse? Let us see.

lines.zh: 地上有块骨头，我认得它。
lines.en: There is a bone on the ground and I recognize it.

lines.zh: 捡东西，会让我慢下来。
lines.en: Picking things up slows me down.

lines.zh: 我不贪，我只要会烧的。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I only want what burns.

lines.zh: 听见你的脚步，我的骨头就热了。
lines.en: Hearing your steps, my bones grow warm.

lines.zh: 目标出现，引信开始发烫。
lines.en: Target spotted; the fuse grows hot.

lines.zh: 你踩在软土上，走不快。
lines.en: You walk slowly on this soft soil.

lines.zh: 四十五点生命，我只用一次。
lines.en: I have forty-five points of life and will spend them once.

lines.zh: 你身上有火光，那正好。
lines.en: You carry firelight, which is perfect.

lines.zh: 我找到你了，在灰堆后面。
lines.en: I found you behind the ash heap.

lines.zh: 别躲，我的骨头闻得到你。
lines.en: Do not hide; my bones can smell you.

lines.zh: 我走过来，就没打算回去。
lines.en: This walk of mine is one way only.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙，替我省了力气。
lines.en: The wall behind you saves me effort.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，比我响太多。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is far louder than mine.

lines.zh: 我听到火药在响，其实是我的骨头。
lines.en: I hear powder crackling; it is really my bones.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我越确定是你。
lines.en: The more you run, the surer I am.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你，也锁定了自己。
lines.en: I have locked onto you and onto myself.

lines.zh: 从现在起，我只剩一件事要做。
lines.en: From now on, I have only one thing left to do.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声让我的骨头响。
lines.en: Your steps set my bones rattling.

lines.zh: 还剩三步，两步，一步。
lines.en: Three paces left, then two, then one.

lines.zh: 我身上开始冒烟了，别奇怪。
lines.en: I am starting to smoke; do not be surprised.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就慢慢走。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and I take my time.

lines.zh: 骨头在体内烧，光从缝里透出来。
lines.en: My bones burn inside, and light leaks through the seams.

lines.zh: 别砍我，砍我会更快。
lines.en: Do not cut me; cutting only speeds it up.

lines.zh: 我数着肋骨，等最后一根。
lines.en: I count my ribs, waiting for the last one.

lines.zh: 你还有时间跑，真的。
lines.en: You still have time to run. Truly.

lines.zh: 我的影子开始发红。
lines.en: My shadow is turning red.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，很像在祈祷。
lines.en: Holding your shield like that looks like praying.

lines.zh: 火从我的眼窝里出来了。
lines.en: Fire is coming out of my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 这一下，我们两个都躲不开。
lines.en: Neither of us can dodge this one.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，也别太远。
lines.en: Not too close, and not too far.

lines.zh: 听见滋滋声了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Hear that sizzling? That is me.

lines.zh: 我把最后一步留给你。
lines.en: I am leaving the last step to you.

lines.zh: 我开始发烫，别慌。
lines.en: I'm getting hot. Don't panic.

lines.zh: 你退，我就把脚步加快。
lines.en: Back away and I'll pick up the pace.

lines.zh: 引信很短，我等不了。
lines.en: The fuse is short. I can't wait.

lines.zh: 这一步之后，就没有回头。
lines.en: After this step there is no going back.

lines.zh: 我抱住你了，别动。
lines.en: I have hold of you; do not move.

lines.zh: 骨头硌人，我知道。
lines.en: Bone is sharp against the skin; I know.

lines.zh: 这一撞不为伤害，只为贴紧。
lines.en: This blow is not for damage, but for closeness.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，火却更旺了。
lines.en: You struck me, and the fire only grew.

lines.zh: 我打你一拳，骨头掉了一节。
lines.en: I punched you and a bone fell off.

lines.zh: 别挣，越挣烧得越快。
lines.en: Do not struggle; struggling burns faster.

lines.zh: 这是我们最近的一次。
lines.en: This is the closest we will ever be.

lines.zh: 我把胸口顶向你，那里最热。
lines.en: I press my chest at you; that is the hottest part.

lines.zh: 你听见我笑了吗？骨头在响。
lines.en: Hear me laughing? That is my bones.

lines.zh: 二点伤害，我从不指望。
lines.en: Two points of damage; I never counted on more.

lines.zh: 抓到你袖口了，很好。
lines.en: I caught your sleeve. Good.

lines.zh: 火已经到我喉咙了。
lines.en: The fire has reached my throat.

lines.zh: 别松手，我不想一个人炸。
lines.en: Do not let go; I do not want to blow up alone.

lines.zh: 最后一下，我保证。
lines.en: One last hit, I promise.

lines.zh: 我张开双臂，抱住你的腰。
lines.en: I open both arms and wrap your waist.

lines.zh: 骨头抵着你，火在里面。
lines.en: Bone against you, and fire inside it.

lines.zh: 我从灰里长出来，骨头先立住。
lines.en: I grew out of the ash, bones first.

lines.zh: 蠕变维度的土翻开，我就到了。
lines.en: Creeponia's soil split, and there I was.

lines.zh: 火药味先出现，然后是我。
lines.en: The smell of powder came first, then me.

lines.zh: 这副骨架是拼起来的，我知道。
lines.en: This skeleton is assembled, and I know it.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，眼窝里就有火。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and fire filled the sockets.

lines.zh: 谁把我埋在这儿的？谢谢。
lines.en: Who buried me here? Thank you.

lines.zh: 骨头落地的声音，把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The sound of bones hitting ground woke me.

lines.zh: 这里比我记得的更灰。
lines.en: This place is grayer than I remember.

lines.zh: 引信一出生就在响。
lines.en: The fuse was already hissing when I was born.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，掉了一地碎骨。
lines.en: When I stood, broken bones fell everywhere.

lines.zh: 新的身体，旧的硫味。
lines.en: A new body, the same old sulfur smell.

lines.zh: 我从地下往上数，数到第九层。
lines.en: I counted upward from below, to the ninth layer.

lines.zh: 地从缝里裂开，我带着火药爬出。
lines.en: The ground split at a seam, and I climbed out with powder.

lines.zh: 骨头先出土，火药味随后就到。
lines.en: Bones surfaced first, the smell of powder right after.

lines.zh: 火对我不是伤害，是催促。
lines.en: Fire is not harm to me; it is a hurry.

lines.zh: 我摔散了，正在把自己拼回去。
lines.en: I shattered on landing and am reassembling myself.

lines.zh: 水浇灭了我，也浇灭了我的脾气。
lines.en: Water put out my fire and my temper.

lines.zh: 炸开了，我的骨头飞到树上。
lines.en: The blast scattered my bones into the trees.

lines.zh: 箭折在我的肋骨缝里。
lines.en: The arrow snapped off between my ribs.

lines.zh: 药水让我的骨头变软，站不稳。
lines.en: The potion softened my bones and I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 这具身体早忘了吃饭这回事。
lines.en: This body forgot about meals a long time ago.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，骨头全白了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me and bleached every bone.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，骨头也留不下。
lines.en: Falling into the void, not even bones remain.
